# The agent step of a round item is lost with a clean worktree. Someone removes the worktree and the base moves while no run is alive.
# The next run recovers the agent step in a worktree made again at the start commit of the run. The note lists no commit of the moved base,
# the engine reads the folder with no error, and the agent starts again at the commit it first saw.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

example local/project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off as it did before the example set it.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
subst flow/round.star
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec beehavereal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

rm state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1
exec git -C origin checkout -q integration/r1
exec git -C origin add MOVED_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m moved
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

exec sh any.sh run run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
grep 'item round/integration/r1 finished' run.out

exists prompt.2
! grep MOVED_MARKER prompt.2
! grep 'could not read the diff summary' prompt.2
cmp agent.head.1 agent.head.2

-- any.sh --
label=$1
shift
beehavereal "$@" > "$label.out" 2> "$label.err"
echo $? > "$label.rc"
-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/MOVED_MARKER --
moved
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    agent(name = "probe", prompt = "prompts/probe.md", model = "m")
-- flow/prompts/probe.md --
Probe the folder.
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
if [ "${1:-}" = "--version" ]; then echo 1.0.0; exit 0; fi
n=$(cat "@WORK@/starts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "@WORK@/starts"
cat > "@WORK@/prompt.$n"
git rev-parse HEAD > "@WORK@/agent.head.$n"
if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then echo x > "@WORK@/started"; sleep 30; fi
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
